title: The Glass Lanterns
premise: Lanterns hold the night back, and each one burns on a rule about vectors.
main_conflict: The lanterns are dying, and only measuring and adding vectors can relight them.

characters.name: Maren
characters.description: Keeps the lanterns and tests every claim.

characters.name: Tobi
characters.description: Asks the questions the player should ask.

world_rules: A lantern only lights when its vector is measured correctly.

story_sequence.title: First Light
story_sequence.purpose: Learn what a vector is and how to add two.
story_sequence.main_conflict: The harbour lantern needs the right heading.

outcomes.description: The story's central problem is fully resolved.
